notes.title: Halloween Event! + More!
notes.content:
Hey all!

Happy to announce a couple of new additions:
- Founder mech has been added
- Discord integration has been added
- new Voxel test map has been added
- return of Sp00k and his zombots, zombots parts have been nerfed to make them a bit more fun to pull apart.

notes.title: IMPACT Build!
notes.content:
Hey all,

It has been a while since the last update, I hope this makes up for it! I am hard at work at multiplayer but will try and get some more abilities added in when I have a spare second. Suggestions for existing parts would be amazing!

New Content:
- Added Toxic Mech 
- Added Tester Mech
- Added Teaster Head Laser Ability

Changes:
- NPCs can now use abilities!
- New Debug buttons! 
      - F3 = Load into a pre-made battle & more set dressing
      - 5 = Spawn NPC with abilities (random parts)
      - 6 = Spawn NPC with abilities that will only fight the player.

- NPCs will now look for the closest enemy when they spawn to fight so can fight one another.

Just want to say thank you all for the support, it has been amazing even with the lack of updates being in the discord and chatting has helped me chug on through the slog that is multiplayer :D

Hope you guys enjoy the update and I will get the smoke parts added back soon!!
-Lazy

notes.title: Settings UI edits, GIF exporter fixes & mech reset button added.
notes.content:
Hey all just a quick patch. 

It was noticed that the GIF exporter was creating a folder everytime you played the game, that is now fixed and it will only create a folder when you save a gif now. 

I am going to also change the directory soon and allow you to set the directory. 

Also with the new control edits some reports of broken mech data came in. So I have added a reset button to the mecha builder where you can reset your mech to fix this. 
You will know if you need to do this because your mech will be invisible on the main menu :D

Finally the new settings I added last night were not added to the UI nicely so I have rejigged the UI to better fit them 

Any issues please let me know via the [url=discord.gg/24UaaDEfFs]Discord[/url]
- Lazy

notes.title: Controller support & remapping added! (kinda)
notes.content:
Hey all after a long while I am happy to say controller support is offically out! The UI is not yet supported but the full game is :)

With this I have also added keyboard re-mapping & controller re-mapping, you can find this in the main menu under "Control Settings".

If you find any issues please hop into the [url=https://www.tiktok.com/link/v2?aid=1988&lang=en&scene=bio_url&target=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F24UaaDEfFs]discord[/url] and let me know and I will sort them ASAP!


Just a small mention, with this update all of the look axis inputs have changed so you will likely need to adjust your camera sensitivity again, sorry about this... these are the perks of testing an very much in development game 

-Lazy

notes.title: Forge V1 & Dominion parts release!
notes.content:
The time has finally come. The Dominion have landed on the red planet. Bringing new mech parts & abilities!

Along with this I am proud to announce the V1 release of forge!

Dominion:
- 5 new parts, Head, 2 new arms, legs and body.
- 3 new abilities, Hook shot, Charge and Ram
(NOTE: the Dominion mech is still pending balancing so feedback is appreciated!)

Forge:
- Pressing F1 in sandbox will now enable forge mode.
- Pressing Tab in forge will open the spawn menu (It is very limited but will grow!)
- Space is used to drop and pick forge blocks shown by the Green lines


All NPCs will disable and enable when entering and exiting forge.

Forge is pending more updates and I will keep you updated via the discord, next up I want to add:
- Spawn menu categories
- Terrain parts
- Forge object options - (NPC teams, respawn times)
- Saving of spawned objects / edited maps

notes.content:
Watch out! A vengful virus has taken control of fallen mechs in your sector, prepare to dive into [b]AI Anarchy[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/URwGljW.png[/img]

T'is the season of the weird, wicked and all things unnatural in Mecha Mayhem this October. Defend your sector from AI enslavement by eradicating the infected zombie-mechs and defeat the corrupted SPO0K in [b]AI Anarchy[/b].

Join the defense before [b]31 October[/b] to receive the[b] season-exclusive Bat Wings Body[/b] to help you take off into the night. Defeating [b]SPO0K [/b]will also earn you a [b]limited edition jack o'lantern head[/b] which includes new weapon capabilities.

Submit your zombie-mech kill of the season to our Discord to be in the chance to win your own physical M0nty mech figurine which comes with more exclusive Mecha Mayhem merch. The most impressively chaotic recorded kill wins!

notes.title: 🤖 HUD update!
notes.content:
Hey all, with this new updated I have just pushed a full HUD overhall. 
This includes:

🤖 Full life bar rework, it now takes up less space & is inline with other mech / vehicle damage indicators.

🤖 New ability HUD additions, these show you the cooldowns, charges / ammo and keybind for you current active abilities.

🤖 New Jump counter, with the addition of batwings this opened the game up to multiple parts adding jumps, so now by your health bars is a handy jump counter.
          - With this above statement I have also rebalanced jump strengths since the strong legs were insanely powerful paired with the bat wings. They still feel great but you just cannot fly as high. Default legs were unchanged by this rebalance. :)


[i]Smaller edits also include:[/i]

🤖 Added a new button on the main menu to launch the halloween event now so sandbox is[b] back again with debug![/b].
🤖 Noticed the grenade launcher hand was not in the mech builder so added that back.
🤖 Added both the pumpkin head & batwings to the mech builder.
🤖 Introduced ammo and cooldowns for all guns
🤖 did a quick art edit to the zombies to make them look a bit more zombie like :D
